list: Sturdy decorative floor tiles, cool to the touch. Recent unrest in the Sky Mirror Pavilion left scratches; when new tiles failed to match the old patterns, the craftsman studied nearby books to hand-paint a solution that wasn't half bad.

A long, sturdy cypress table found in the corner of the hall. The table light illuminates an area one chi wide; one can read here while waiting for others, and if they want to finish the book afterward, the hall will gift it to them.

Unique lights once used for other purposes. Baizao elders say they were to cage fireflies, while fortune tellers say it was a shrine for divinity. Today it is known by the masses as 'the lantern of Sky Mirror Pavilion'.

An intricate censer emanating crimson mist, its surface chiseled with lotus motifs. No need to wake a napping friend in the reception hall; simply light some incense, and they will soon realize their slight lapse in decorum.

An antique screen, adorned with profound, timeless brushwork. Visitors are amazed by its mysterious meaning, unaware they are merely random splotches added by the Magistrate of Water after spilling ink on it.

Jade pendants with mini gongs and jade huangs mark book zones. Ten steps equal a year's worth of archives, and miscounting the pendants means starting over. Being a good scholar here does not just mean skill with the brush.

A translucent mist-like curtain that conceals. Not all guests come with good intentions, and it acts as a tangible boundary and an invisible mirror. If talk goes sour, lowering the curtain is one way to maintain a graceful distance.
Stone lamps for late visitors that never go out. Historians are more likely to lose themselves in the past as they dream of their writings, but this dazzling light ensures they do not forget reality.

A quiet, elegant wallpaper framing Baizao's grand buildings in the background. 'Mr. Liang often read here until midnight and couldn't be woken the next day. He clearly loved this tiny realm.'—A note from the Magistrate of Water.
theme: Recreated from Sky Mirror Pavilion's reception hall. Usually used for talks, conflict resolution, fundraising, trade discussions, weiqi games and lectures. At last reopened after a long closure—its closed-door history remains unknown.

list:
You have journeyed all across Yan, seen the summers and winters, and witnessed the sun and moons rise and fall many times.
The years come and go, and sun and moon mark the ages, but he has made them his eyes, seeing the dead end when he opens them, and the mortal world when he closes them.
During the First of A Thousand Autumns event, obtain the free Operator Ju

You met a craftsman with a strange appearance in Baizao under the setting sun. The two of you chatted about your ambitions, and it was late night before you knew it.
Seeking similarity, admiring the virtuous, fostering universal love and mutual benefit... He believes in the same things you do, you both are guided by reason, and neither of you fears fate. It was a meeting of mutual delight.
During the First of A Thousand Autumns event, consume 4000 'Draft of History' in [Sky Mirror Teahouse]

You visited famous mountains and delivered the historical documents you found to the calm Magistrate of Water, always buried in scrolls in the Sky Mirror Pavilion.
Years roll on, and heaven and earth are vast. How could one not fear? How could one not like it?
Complete all stages in [Record of An Autumn's End] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

You were invited to a game of weiqi. Another autumn had come by the time you looked up again.
A new autumn, or the first autumn.
Complete all the content in [Proofreading of the Past] and collect the rewards

You touched every intersection of the nineteen lines, vertical and horizontal. Now you understand the Black player's painstaking journey, and the White player's fury.
One should know their limits, and act at the right moment. But it is those who seek a way through the impossible who understand people's hearts the best.
Clear TA-9 with a 3-star rating and make 'Wield Arms' fall into pits at least 4 times

You sit across from the strategist. The distant enemies are destroyed as the two of you talk.
No one was born a strategist, and few can reach the uncharted, distant realms, but this round will be his.
During the First of A Thousand Autumns event, use 'Writing Knife' a total of 10 times

You reunite with an old friend, and see knife and sword in her hand.
Many things have happened, but she remains true to her ideals, fighting for justice from country to country.
Complete all stages in [Forgotten Prospect of Spring] on Challenge Mode

You return to Baizao with the rest. The age of Sui is past, and the spring of 'humanity' is about to dawn.
When the truth is revealed, and forgotten secrets come to light, you will see that the people of this ancient land have more courage to face their past than you think.
Complete all stages in [Unwritten Chapters of Yan] on Challenge Mode

You slowly spread open the sheet of paper, and seem to see people both past and present walk towards you.
Leave all that has come to pass to historians' scrolls. They shall faithfully record all that we've done.

You witnessed the fall of Sui.
The bestial Sui closes Its eyes, and the thousand-year calamity has finally come to an end. What night is this night, that the moons are so bright?
set: First of A Thousand Autumns Engraved Medal Set

An Engraved Medal Set that records a long journey to Yan.
Finally, after the chaos, the family gathers around the table for a reunion dinner, bringing back both stories and souvenirs from afar. The bowls and chopsticks are set, and soon, the sibling they have not seen for a long time is coming back.
